menuItemexport01.label: Export Selected
menuItemexport01.onClick: {{ (function(){ var ids = (LocationsGrid.model && LocationsGrid.model.selectedIds) || []; var rows = (getLocationLists.data || []).filter(function(r){ return ids.indexOf(r.id) >= 0; }); if (!rows.length) { showAlert('No locations selected.', 'warning'); return; } var cols = Object.keys(rows[0]); var csv = [cols.join(',')].concat(rows.map(function(r){ return cols.map(function(c){ var v = r[c]; return (typeof v === 'string' && v.indexOf(',') >= 0) ? ('"' + v.replace(/"/g,'""') + '"') : v; }).join(','); })).join('\n'); download(csv, 'locations_selected.csv', 'text/csv'); })() }}

menuItemdelete01.label: Delete Selected
menuItemdelete01.onClick: {{ showAlert(((LocationsGrid.model && LocationsGrid.model.selectedCount) || 0) + ' location(s) selected. Bulk delete is not enabled in this app.', 'info') }}
